note: One specimen (13460), left eye; 1.24 is the mean Δφ with its spread across the eye (+-0.81). where: Table 1, p. 3 of the accepted manuscript (TARA); columns Species, CFF, Mg, qWg, Brain mass, Light levels. The quote is the whole row as printed, superscripts run on
note: Compiled in Table 1 ('Data set used in main analysis') of Healy et al. 2013. The superscripts on the CFF cell give the measurement type (e = electroretinogram), the methodology class (o = optimum) and the data source (7, Hanyu & Ali (1963)). The extracted mass and metabolic-rate cells run reference numbers into their digits (for example a trailing 28 or 29, which match the reference list's Makarieva et al. 2008 and Rogowitz 1996), so only the CFF value is carried. An asterisk on qWg marks a metabolic rate 'estimated from swimming speeds extrapolated to zero'; NA is a missing brain mass; the last cell is the light level (H high, L low). Published record (Crossref): Animal Behaviour 86(4):685-696.
